text: Revenue went up by 2000 BRL between 2017-05 and 2017-06. The largest contribution came from MG (1200 BRL). The second largest contribution came from BA (800 BRL). Revenue is defined as: Total payments received for delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
